What does the circular say about annual leave carry-over?

send.payload_preview: Question: What does the circular say about annual leave carry-over? Passages: Leave Circular 2024, page 3.

send.text: Staff may carry over up to five unused leave days into the next year [Leave Circular 2024, page 3]. Days not used by 31 March lapse [Leave Circular 2024, page 3].

citations.passage: Up to five unused days of annual leave may be carried over to the next calendar year. Carried-over days not used by 31 March lapse.

send.text: You can carry over up to five days. Say show me to open the circular.
